But they become impatient, so Duggee makes sure to explain to them that the week will fly by and there's a lot to be done in that time. Duggee explains that a week is made up of seven days and what activities he does each day to stay busy. Each squirrel excitedly shares their usual plans between Monday and Friday so that they have something to look forward to while they wait f

programme.title: Ready Or Not

programme.title: Mount Rushmore, USA
programme.desc: The Go Jetters have gone to Mount Rushmore, to see the carvings of the President's faces in the mountainside, but there's a less presidential face adorning the monument - and it has a moustache! The Go Jetters launch the Vroomster to investigate and soon realize that Glitch's face isn't carved into the mountainside at all, but moulded from mud - this is going to be easy to fix, right?

programme.title: Fig

programme.title: A Bride For A Ride
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUN

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the comp

programme.title: Barrack O'Karma
programme.desc: Siu Wai-ming (Joel Chan) becomes a security guard at Twilight Mansion, a run-down place where dodgy characters roam around. He encounters an occupant by the name of Alex (Selena Lee), who is an air hostess and a dead ringer for some qipao clad woman that keeps clinging to him in his dreams. Siu gets closer to Alex and finds out they are somehow interrelated. Meanwhile, strange things keep happening at Twilight Mansion as life experiences and curious stories of other occupants take center stage.

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN's bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG's lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI's (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne

programme.title: Always And Ever
programme.desc: Due to a heartrending vow, YUEN KAM-CHEONG (Bobby Au Yeung), an Inspector of the Criminal Intelligence Bureau, has mistakenly killed his girlfriend YEUNG TSIK-SUET (Esther Kwan). Being so grief-stricken, KAM-CHEONG has an out-of-body experience, travelling back in time to the Song Dynasty. programme.desc: From immersive experiences to live streaming, National Women's Soccer League Chief Marketing and Commercial Officer Julie Haddon discusses the opportunities for growing women's professional sports.

programme.title: Animal Communication

programme.title: Quantum Computing
programme.desc: With the promise of unimaginable computing power, a global race for quantum supremacy is raging. Who will be first to harness this new technological force, and what will they do with it?

programme.title: Water

programme.title: Pain
programme.desc: For some, pain is excruciating and inescapable. But amid the continuing fallout of the opioid crisis, new technologies are being developed to limit and even eliminate pain.

programme.title: Next Billion

programme.title: Robots: The Aliens We Made

programme.title: Love in the Age of Machines

programme.title: Your Brain Is the Next Tech Frontier

programme.title: Does the Perfect City Exist?

programme.title: Karlie Kloss on Reviving Magazines

programme.title: Swimming Fools / The Goobfather
programme.desc: SpongeBob builds a pool in his backyard and Squidward tries to resist taking a dip. // Mr. Krabs must reckon with the Goobfather after he adds "Patty Whips" to the menu at the Krusty Krab.

programme.title: Pet / Snack
programme.desc: Pinky sets out to turn a wild cat into the perfect pet. // When Pinky finds out a beloved local snack food is being discontinued, he makes it his mission to re-create the treat for the sake of future generations.

programme.title: Jade the Juggler / Parcel Chase
programme.desc: Jade tries to help too many people and ends up causing chaos in the process! // The Twins ask the Marsupilamis to wait for an important parcel, but they miss it, so try and retrieve it from the depot.

programme.title: Meet the Purrents / Apartment Complex
programme.desc: When Lori and Bobby find a kitten, they decide to coparent and swap the kitten back and forth between their homes. // After telling her family how great her apartment is, Lori unknowingly entices her sisters to secretly take over her space.

programme.title: Pet Project / Cuff Break
programme.desc: When Mom and the twins win a raffle to spend a weekend at a resort, Lana struggles to leave her pets behind. // After Lincoln tests a magic trick on Grouse, they get handcuffed together and Grouse has to spend the day at middle school.

programme.title: Prom-Com / Scene Steeler
programme.desc: When Leni is put in charge of the school's prom, she is determined to make it the most memorable night ever. // Lincoln and Clyde cast Luan as the villain, Bee Trayal, in their David Steele film and have to deal with her method acting.

programme.title: Rough Patch / The GLOAT
programme.desc: To earn her next patch and become a golden Snickerdoodle, Lola must spend quality time with Sunset Canyon senior, Bernie. // After Lynn sees cousin Shiloh's athletic skills, she gets overly competitive to prove she's the greatest Loud of all time.

programme.title: From Dust Till Dawn
programme.desc: Chloe is struggling with her leadership skills, but when a villain attacks her school field trip, Max and Phoebe have to put Chloe in charge while they try to take down the villain and defuse his dangerous astronomical weapon.

programme.title: The Max of Life
programme.desc: Missing fame and fans, Max decides to recapture some glory by breaking Booch's sandwich-stacking record at Splat by the Sea, but Chloe challenges him so that her friend can have her record back.

programme.title: Mime Games
programme.desc: When Danger Force and Captain Man are called to Paris to protect France's national treasures, Bose is accidentally left alone to try and stop The Toddler from breaking into The Man's Nest.

programme.title: Drive Hard
programme.desc: Captain Man and Danger Force are hired to deliver a big budget Hollywood movie to its premiere but the producer warns them that rival studios and internet trolls are out to steal the movie.

programme.title: Balloons Of Doom
programme.desc: When Dr. Minyak takes the Man Fans hostage, Captain Man and Kid Danger have to find a way to rescue them without Dr. Minyak seeing them move.

programme.title: You-Go-Girl-Kart
programme.desc: Lay Lay joins the auto club to create a fast and stylish ride, but Sadie is concerned that Lay Lay's fast and furious style will expose their secret. Marky and Jeremy get Tiffany to promote their new invention, candles that blow themselves out.

programme.title: The Heat is on / Dig disaster
programme.desc: It's the Chahuta's Chili eating contest, and soon it's revealed Marcel's a cheat. // When Hope takes Gran Gran's special ladle to the park to play it ends up at Professor Lopez's archaeological dig.

programme.title: Stan's showtime / The Truth is Out There
programme.desc: Stan claims to have a real Marsupilami appearing in a show he's putting on, but it's a fake robot. // Acu thinks a fish-loving alien is in town, and Mica offers to help him track it down.

programme.title: Sock / Count
programme.desc: When Pinky loses a sock, he decides to wear all his clothes at the same time to keep it from happening again. // A "count your steps" app inspires Pinky, Babs and JJ to keep track of their daily activity, but it also nearly drives the friends apart.

programme.title: The Sweet Spot / A Tale of Two Tables
programme.desc: Lincoln devises a plan to get the best seat in the car for a long, family, road trip. // Lincoln tries to prove he's mature enough to have dinner at the adult table, leaving the kiddie table behind him.

programme.title: Snow Bored
programme.desc: The Loud kids set out to show Lisa what is “fun” about a snow day.

programme.title: Ghost of a Chance
programme.desc: The full Chaos Council gears up for all-out war in Ghost Hill. Shadow worries about leaving Nine to rebuild the prism. Sonic insists Nine is a friend - they have a plan to fix the world together. The Council discovers two superpowered hedgehogs.

programme.title: Squid Plus One / The Executive Treatment
programme.desc: After receiving an invitation to a gallery opening, Squidward scrambles to find a friend to take with him. // While trying to order a special sandwich, Patrick gets swept up in the fast paced world of business.

programme.title: Mass Gramp-nosis / Cart of Darkness
programme.desc: Patrick hypnotizes everyone in Bikini Bottom into becoming GrandPats. // Squidina leads Patrick on a grocery shopping mission.

programme.title: Golfalami / Mar-Sleepwalker
programme.desc: The twins and Marsupilamis game of golf results in Hope and Punch being caught by Stan. // The Twins have Callie for a sleepover and whilst sleepwalking she meets the Marsupilamis.

programme.title: Runaway Hope
programme.desc: Hope finds a bouncy ball of moss it's so comfortable she sleeps in it, but it bounces off.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 1 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: A disgraced doctor Aiman Salihin gets invited by a mysterious man, Aaron Pestana, to become a doctor at a hidden hospital catering to the wealthiest and the criminals. In return, he will help to find a donor for Aiman's grandmother whose time is running out for a transplant. Desperate to rescue his only living relative, Aiman is forced to question his morality and his code.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 2 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: Aiman starts his new job at "The Ward" by grazing the nerves of everyone, including Hera and Dione. But when their lives turn into a life and death situation, Aiman must learn to trust his new team. Meanwhile, Aaron Pestana discovers the mob boss's son, Haikal is planning to usurp his business by creating a new ward.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 3 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: When a young boy gets knocked down by a hit-and-run driver, Aiman starts performing CPR on him but realizes it's too late. Sadden that he couldn't save the boy, Aiman is shocked to realize the hit-and-run driver is the new patient at "The Ward". Meanwhile, Pestana is trying to hide his tremors and imaginary voices but Haikal might very well have caught it.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 4 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: A new client, Chiam Wee Lai, arrives to be treated at "The Ward". But Aiman is threatened by Haikal to murder Chiam Wee Lai at the operating table or his grandmother will die. Back at the station, Syirah's idea to investigate an underground doctor gets shredded by her superior, Andrea Shelley. She wants facts and proof. Syirah is determined to get one.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 5 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: When a heavily pregnant young woman, Hannah, is brought in to "The Ward" to give birth, Aiman feels compassionate upon hearing her plight until she holds Aiman hostage in a bid to run away with her baby! Back at police HQ, Darwis tells Syirah that Shelley is taking their case to the board as her own unless Syirah's there. Syirah is torn between work and her son.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 6 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: Aiman goes all out on his next patient, Dr Khai Budiman, the doctor leading the cure on Goodpasture Syndrome, who can save his grandmother's life despite knowing another soul will be taken away. Meanwhile, Syirah and Darwis are assigned to investigate a case of trespass in an old folks home but realize that the case may be the turning point to finding Chiron.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 7 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: A deadly sabotage on Pestana's goods and his men begins the war between JD and Pestana. But Pestana is unperturbed, even cold which worries Ryo greatly. Aiman gets to work in treating the sole survivor from the sabotage only to discover he's an undercover cop. With so much on the line, Hera is beginning to suspect Dione is stealing drug vials from The Ward.

programme.title: (PG) The Man With The Plan (Mal Subs)
programme.desc: When Haiz Salihin comes up with the perfect heist right after his release from prison, all he needs now is a perfect team to bring it all together. Putting together a team --- both old and new --- the plan is set in motion. But luck runs out even before they can get to the good part. Will the con man be able to con his way out of this?

programme.title: Episode 1 - Fighting Without Fear
programme.desc: (Dual Language Malay and English) On their way to get more information about Warmaster Pyrapi, BoBoiBoy and friends receive a distress call from the NuBot robot factory. There, BoBoiBoy, Gopal, Qually, and Ochobot face an unexpected new enemy which forces BoBoiBoy to reveal a new fusion power, BoBoiBoy Gentar!

programme.title: Episode 11 (Mal Subs)
programme.desc: For those who loves to fish, this program would be very suitable option for the audience. The program describes all about fishing in very attractive way and fun.

programme.title: Episode 6 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: Malaysia’s top fishing sifus, especially from Borneo, compete in an intense showdown to catch rare and massive game fish found only in remote locations. Venturing deep into Upper Borneo near the Kalimantan border, they face extreme terrain, unpredictable waters, and high-stakes challenges—all in pursuit of the ultimate title: Fishing Guru.

programme.title: Episode 6 (Eng/Mal Subs)

programme.title: National Day Message 2026
programme.desc: This year, Singapore celebrates its 61st National Day. Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs, and Senior Minister of State for Defence Zaqy Mohamad delivers the National Day Message on behalf of Prime Minister Lawrence Wong in Malay.

programme.title: Episode 4: Malay Music (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: Asli, Joget, Inang and Zapin are a few of many Malay music genres explored by our host, Zaki Hussain. In this final episode, he meets local percussionist, Uan Abang, and Ariffin Abdullah from Sri Mahligai, a Malay traditional/folk ensemble. Through this exchange, Zaki learns and is challenged to play a music instrument. He also discovers the importance of instilling interest among the young in Malay music.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 7: Siglap (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: Perched by the eastern sea, Kampong Siglap was a coastal Malay settlement known for its kelong fishermen, communal wells, and tightly knit kampong spirit. In this episode, we trace its transformation from sandy shores and attap homes to the reclaimed coastlines that reshaped the area, where the sea once lapped at doorsteps, highways and high-rises now stretch. A journey into a kampung whose roots lie buried beneath reclaimed land and memories.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 12 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: Rita finds herself torn between Zack and Iskandar as she struggles to understand her true feelings. Things take an unexpected turn when Iskandar confesses his feelings for her, leaving Rita speechless.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 14 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: Eager to get money from Datin Munirah, Kamsiah tries to persuade her mother to support Zarif’s proposal to marry Dian. Later, Zarif begins to doubt both himself and his plan to marry Dian.

programme.title: Episode 130
programme.desc: Catch the latest local and international news on Suria.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 8 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: When Ryo's men gets taken in by the police for gun possession, he has no choice but to pickup their latest goods himself, a drug mule. But chaos ensues when the mule' gets shot by JD out of spite and to complicate matters, Syirah and Darwis arrives! Dione is determined to drown herself in sorrow with the drugs but this time, she may have taken too much.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 9 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: Syirah's stake out on Pestana comes to fruition as she manages to plant a tracking device on his car hoping it will lead her to the very location of "The Ward". Meanwhile, Aiman goes AWOL and Dione is forced to takeover as the lead Doctor. But when the male patient arrives bleeding from a missing private part, Hera knows there's an abused victim who's in need of urgent help.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 10 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: Pestana is growing agitated that Ryo is missing. But when he's finally found unconscious in a warehouse, he is quickly brought back to "The Ward", where they discover he has been operated on. After Rizki's close call with death, Syirah rethinks about her priorities and decides to abandon her obsession on the case only to find a shocking clue.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 11 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: Pestana finds himself at the mercy of Mak Mah as he is taken away to an off site. Moving in and out of consciousness, Pestana is thrown back into his memories when he was young and struggling to take care of his father. Pestana's life will change forever when he meets Mak Mah for the first time.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 12 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: Time is running out to save Nenek's life. Mak Mah has just given Aiman the donor's whereabouts but Aiman realizes that he has to take a life of someone he wasn't expecting. The police gets a lead on Pestana's location and are preparing to ambush the place. As Pestana tries to find a way to escape, there might just be someone who can help him do so.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 13 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: With Nenek gone, Aiman is stone cold and seeks revenge on Pestana. With Mak Mah's help, Aiman goes on a hunt, but JD is not pleased with this plan, for he has his own revenge in mind. With Dione in police custody, Syirah finds out Aiman's whereabouts and maybe this time, she can finally get hold of the two wanted men and bring this to an end.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 1 (Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: Lately, Izan's rest time is interrupted by loud noises and plates being hurled and broken, coming from the neighbor's home. Being the inquisitive Izan, she musters her courage and tries to talk to her neighbor. Izan is pushed away but little by little, the truth starts to come to light. From loud shouting, the situation escalates quickly.

programme.title: (PG) A New Beginning
programme.desc: Linda wants to rent out part of her salon to another hairstylist to compliment her business. Little did she expect the flyers she had posted around town, attracted everyone else but the right candidate. Eventually Andy Ahmad appeared and turned her life upside down when he decided to give her precious salon a makeover.

programme.title: Episode 2 - Heroes in Distress

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness & innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed “The Invincible Fist” is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiancé so as to drive away two women whom he does not like…

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiancé, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummer/leader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo's brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu's house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hu's pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat's knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit…

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiancé Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan…

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes

programme.desc: Asia has the longest coastline of any continent and the richest coral reefs on earth. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Hail the Judge
programme.desc: A low level magistrate is run out of town for defending a beautiful murder suspect. Through a series of comedic events he ascends to the top rank & returns looking for revenge.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to “Casino Tycoon”. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down…

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang’s custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandora’s Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.
